purpose: Whole-project clean rebuild of the Lean project of release v1.17.0 (adds Paper 1 version 3).
result: 2999 of 2999 modules compiled; 2998 of 2999 replayed with leanchecker; the module Research has no constants and was exempted; 0 audit problems.
computer: the author's Windows computer (63 GB of memory, 16 logical CPUs)
procedure: New empty output directory; sources copied from the release tree lean/ (Research.lean and Research/, 3001 files, of which 2999 are Lean modules). After the build their SHA-256 hashes were compared with the release tree: no difference. The directory Comparator/ was not built here; it is unchanged since version 1.13.0, and the CI workflow checks it.
Each module compiled with lean -DautoImplicit=false -DrelaxedAutoImplicit=false, then each module replayed with leanchecker, by the driver build6.py of version 1.16.0. This is not a lake build.
Warnings are recorded and do not fail a module; an error, sorry or non-zero exit code does.

runs.note: One run, up to 14 jobs. Compile phase until 04:18:23Z, leanchecker phase from 04:18:24Z. Every module passed at the first attempt; no log has the suffix .attemptN. Final status: status.json.

module_Research.how_counted: readModuleData on Research.olean (research-olean-constants.txt in the log archive)
module_Research.consequence: leanchecker has nothing to replay in this module. It was exempted before the run, as for versions 1.15.0 and 1.16.0.

warnings: 97 lines in 15 older modules, the same as for version 1.16.0; none in Paper 1 or in the 45 new modules Research/TaskE/.
axioms: every printed axiom list is a subset of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The 7 lists printed by Research.TaskE.FinalTaskEAudit (among them check_SameParityThree and check_SameParityThreeMinEight) and the list printed by Research.TaskE.C1High are each exactly these three axioms.
